thesis: The speaker argues that the economy is currently running at record-high leverage while asset prices are priced for perfection, creating low resiliency against a one-in-a-hundred-year storm caused by the coronavirus pandemic. He states that while this situation is not the end of the world and historical precedents like the Civil War and World Wars show the U.S. can recover and become a great power, the lack of experience with recessions among adults makes the scenario difficult to navigate.
